answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The glacier lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the crystal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work.
